Bug_Explanation: The code uses double-brace initialization to initialize an ArrayList. This creates an anonymous inner class with an instance initializer block, which can lead to memory leaks in non-static contexts. The bug is that the entire enclosing instance cannot be garbage collected if the collection is retained elsewhere.
Trigger_Explanation: The testShowBug method calls showBug, which uses double-brace initialization causing a memory leak in non-static context, thus failing the test.
